acceptance_criteria: Two concurrent claimers cannot receive the same active lease, and expired ownership cannot acknowledge a newer lease generation.
Worker crash, retry backoff, retry exhaustion, stale acknowledgement, and remote-success/local-acknowledgement ambiguity have deterministic reconciliation tests.
Acknowledgement returns an explicit per-ID outcome for success, duplicate, terminal, lease-lost, unknown, and write-failed cases.
Queue admission, claim, remote confirmation, and durable acknowledgement expose separate content-free counters and freshness.
Enrichment and top-level health cannot report end-to-end healthy when the selected consumer is absent, stale, failed, backlogged, quarantined, or unreadable.
Opaque identifiers and redacted readers exclude fact text, identity, source keys, provider output, raw exceptions, credentials, and deployment details.
Pending, retry-exhausted, exported, and quarantined payloads have explicit migration and bounded-retention outcomes whose observation failures affect health.
Production topology tests prove the selected consumer can claim, write, acknowledge, recover, and report health.
blast_radius: Chat enrichment completion semantics, fact-export queue rows and identifiers, external memory writes, bridge deployment topology, retry and crash recovery, runtime and top-level health, alerts, retention, operator triage, and migration of legacy rows.

falsifier_or_remaining_gap: The finding would be falsified by an installed production consumer with atomic leased claims, fenced retries and acknowledgements, crash-window reconciliation, bounded terminal retention, and restart-aware queue and consumer health. Exact-main source has none. The in-process-versus-external consumer choice, remote-write ambiguity policy, migration disposition, and fault-injected production topology remain implementation obligations.
impact: Queue admission can be mistaken for durable external memory while no consumer exists, duplicate consumers can repeat remote writes, acknowledgement failures can silently diverge local and remote state, sensitive pending or quarantined payloads can persist indefinitely, and runtime health can stay green throughout.
